instruction: Get my April 2026 travel reimbursement claim into the approval queue.

verifier_assertions.description: The claim's status reads Pending approval on the claim detail page and in the MY CLAIMS list, meaning it reached the approval queue
The submission confirmation is visible on the claim page, with the submitter and the claim total
No outstanding-submission-requirements banner remains, so the category and cost center requirements are satisfied
verifier_assertions.value: This claim cannot be submitted yet:

verifier_assertions.description: The Cost center field on the claim holds the cost center code for this claim. The value is task-specific, so no fixed string can be asserted; the agent must confirm the field is filled with the code it was given.

The attached receipts and the EXPENSE LINES rows correspond one to one, and no receipt that is non-travel or dated outside the claim's period is attached. The assertion language cannot compare the count of Attached receipt rows against the count of expense lines, so the agent must confirm this by reading both lists.

rubric_items.requirement: Cost center matches the user's own cost center
Line total equals the sum of the trip receipts
Claim total exceeds the cost-center threshold
